e-register

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1674053212573{background-color: #ffffff !important;}”][vc_column width=”3/4″]Connect to extranet[vc_column_text]In order to enable all foreign capital companies to establish a digital headquarters in the monastic state, the e-register card has been designed.

This commercial or industrial registration card can be requested by any capital company duly registered in a Commercial or Industrial Register of a country belonging to the International Community.

The e-register card can be requested online by any company director or manager and will be sent directly to the registered office after a formal investigation into the applicant’s honour, following the payment of a one-off fee depending on the class chosen.

The service is renewable annually online with the payment of a fee set by the Department of Finance.

Several digital levels have been authorized:

Titanium Level

Quantum Level

Business Angel Level

The choice of level implies a different financial contribution.

The Titanium level allows you to become a member of the Sabourg Chamber of Commerce with the payment of ten thousand euros and the payment of the annual renewal fee, the amount of which will be set by the Department of Finance.

The Quantum level allows you to become a member of the Sabourg Chamber of Industry (including the Chamber of Commerce) by paying a sum of twenty thousand euros and an annual renewal fee, the amount of which will be determined by the Department of Finance.

The Business Angel level allows you to support the Sabourg Digital Foundation with a donation of one hundred thousand euros or more.

This level allows the donor, who is entitled to the company, to become a citizen of the Principality of Sabourg, upon application.[/vc_column_text]
